summary.text: Zoe Manos is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 12 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Democratic primary.
An attorney, she serves on the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Zoe Manos lives in Stratham, New Hampshire, graduated from Memorial High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Antioch College in 1977 and a law degree from the Catholic University of America, Columbus School of Law in 1983.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Stratham since 1999, is an attorney in New Hampshire and Massachusetts, and represented children and parents in neglect and abuse cases for 23 years.
She said she was elected as a state representative in November 2022 and works on the Judiciary Committee.
In the same survey, Manos named the cost of living, including property taxes, housing costs, child care and electric rates, as a main campaign message.

She also said she is concerned about large AI data centers and is working with others in the House on legislation that would give municipalities authority to regulate them, and that she is strongly pro-choice.
She named reproductive rights and domestic violence as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
